english.note: Use 講到 as the all-purpose spoken choice when mentioning, discussing, or being about a topic.

examples.english: When we refer to this brand, we usually mean the restaurant in Causeway Bay.
examples.traditional: 講到呢個品牌，我哋通常係指銅鑼灣嗰間餐廳。
